title: Carabiner Fatigue: What Finsterwalder and Charly's Research Paper Tells Us

summary: A solo episode on the one piece of equipment almost nobody inspects properly. Thomas Finsterwalder could not join the show, so he sent over a research paper on material fatigue instead. This episode works through what fatigue is, why a carabiner can fail while looking perfectly fine, what the manufacturer guidelines actually ask of you, and what to do about it this week.
